title: I could not find what I was looking for

comments.body: You seem to be using `  const content = hit._highlightResult.html.value;` in your code (`hitTemplate`); but some hits don't have `html`, which causes the error to show up. You should try/catch that and instead give a default value of `""`. Can you try that?

Thank you for your answer, by I didn't know how should I do, so I put my `_include/algolia.html` up, and rewrited my question.

I modified the contents of  `_data/header`, 
from `- title: search  
url:   /search/`
to
`- title: search  
url:   /search.html`
but it still didn't work.

And I changed `const content = hit._highlightResult.html.value;` to `const content = hit._highlightResult."".value;`, however, this practice has caused the normal display of the new browser to be invalid.

Sorry if that wasn't clear, I meant to change that line to: 

```js
const content = hit._highlightResult.html && hit._highlightResult.html.value || "";
```
@yefeiyu Do you have any errors in the console?

I feel sad, it still has no effect
Although the address of the blog ends with "...../search/", it's still a `.html` page.
Is it the cause of the `instantsearch.js`?

When I open [https://algolia.github.io](https://algolia.github.io), I found it has the same error!

@yefeiyu, you're using `const` and other modern JavaScript, which isn't supported in older browsers like you're using (conkeror and iOS 9). For that you can take a look at [babel](https://babeljs.io). 

Feel free to open a new issue or continue here if that didn't help :)
